check_domain.description: Find out whether one domain is free to register. An available domain comes back with its first-year price, what it renews at and the registrar offering it, plus a link to buy it. A taken one comes back with the year it was registered and whether it is listed for sale. When DigMyName can't be sure, the status is 'unknown' and says why, rather than guessing.
check_domain.display_str_template: Check whether {0} is available on DigMyName.
check_domain.name: check_domain

parameters.description: The full domain, such as acme.com. A pasted web address works too: https://www.acme.com/about is checked as acme.com.
parameters.name: domain

available.description: True only when the domain is confirmed free.

buy_url.description: Where to register it: the registrar's own search when one is known, otherwise DigMyName's comparison page.

cheapest_registrar.description: The registrar offering that first-year price.

compare_url.description: DigMyName's page comparing this name across extensions and registrars.

domain.description: The domain checked, such as acme.io.

extension.description: Its extension without the dot, such as io.

first_year_price_usd.description: What the first year costs at the cheapest registrar, in US dollars. Only for an available, non-premium domain.

for_sale.description: Whether a taken domain is listed for sale by its owner.

listing_url.description: Where it is listed for sale, when it is.

name.description: The domain without its extension, such as acme.

possibly_premium.description: Whether the name looks like one a registry would price at a premium (short or a common word), though that is not confirmed.

premium.description: Whether the registry sells this name at its own premium price. No price is given then; follow the buy link.

registered_year.description: The year a taken domain was first registered, where it is known.

renewal_price_usd.description: What each year after the first costs at that registrar, in US dollars.

status.description: 'available', 'taken' or 'unknown'. Unknown means DigMyName could not be sure either way; it is never reported as available.

status_note.description: Why, in words, when there is more to say: why it is unknown, that it is for sale, premium or trademark-blocked. Empty otherwise.

compare_registrars.description: Compare what each registrar DigMyName tracks (Cloudflare, GoDaddy, Namecheap, OVHcloud, Porkbun and Spaceship) charges for one extension: the first year, each renewal, a transfer and the total over three years, with any promotion code and whether domain privacy is included. Renewal is where a cheap first year often catches people out, so the cheapest for each is named separately.
compare_registrars.display_str_template: Compare registrar prices for {0} on DigMyName.
compare_registrars.name: compare_registrars

parameters.description: The extension to price, such as .com or .io. Pick from the list, or type one.
parameters.name: extension

parameters.description: Which price to rank the registrars by.
parameters.name: sort

parameters.description: Leave empty to compare every registrar, or pick the ones you would actually use.
parameters.name: registrars

cheapest_first_year.description: The registrar with the lowest first year.

cheapest_renewal.description: The registrar with the lowest renewal.

cheapest_three_years.description: The registrar that costs least over three years.

compare_url.description: DigMyName's page for this extension, with the date each price was last checked.

count.description: How many registrars are in this result.

extension.description: The extension priced, without the dot.

is_tracked.description: Whether DigMyName tracks prices for this extension at all.

registrars.description: The registrars, in the order asked for.

first_year_price_usd.description: The first year's price, in US dollars.

promo_code.description: A promotion code the first-year price depends on, if there is one.

register_url.description: The registrar's own domain search page.

registrar.description: The registrar's name, such as Cloudflare.

renewal_price_usd.description: What each later year costs, in US dollars.

three_year_cost_usd.description: The first year plus two renewals, in US dollars: the fairest single number for comparing registrars.

transfer_price_usd.description: What moving a domain you own to this registrar costs, in US dollars. Empty where it does not take transfers of this extension.

whois_privacy_included.description: Whether hiding your name and address from the public domain record is included free.

get_registration_dates.description: Look up when registered domains were first registered and when they expire, for up to 50 at a time: useful for keeping an eye on your own renewals or on a name you hope will lapse. Each comes back with its age in years and the days left before it expires.
get_registration_dates.display_str_template: Get registration dates for {0} from DigMyName.
get_registration_dates.name: get_registration_dates

description: Find a domain name that is free and see what it really costs. DigMyName checks availability across more than 50 extensions and compares the first-year, renewal and three-year prices of six registrars: Cloudflare, GoDaddy, Namecheap, OVHcloud, Porkbun and Spaceship. Check one domain, try a name across many extensions at once, screen a list of ideas, compare registrars for an extension, or look up when a domain was registered and when it expires.
